title: Neon Serpent
text: The timeless snake, Signature-style: guide the neon serpent, eat the orbs, don't bite yourself. Speeds up as you feast. Controls: Arrow keys / WASD or swipe. Eat orbs to grow. Difficulty: Easy to learn, hard to master.

title: Brick Breaker Blitz
text: Smash every brick with the bouncing power-ball. Catch falling power-ups: wide paddle, multi-ball, laser. Controls: Left/Right arrows or mouse/touch to move the paddle. Difficulty: Easy.

title: Star Vanguard
text: Classic vertical space shooter: weave through the swarm, blast the invaders, survive the waves. Boss every 5 waves. Controls: Arrows/WASD to fly, Space to shoot. Difficulty: Medium.

title: Turbo Circuit
text: Top-down championship racing: 3 laps, 5 rivals, boost pads and oil slicks. Finish first to take the cup. Controls: Up = gas, Down = brake, Left/Right = steer. Difficulty: Medium.

title: Pixel Hopper
text: Run, jump and bounce across the floating islands. Grab every star coin, stomp the grumblers, reach the flag. Controls: Arrows/WASD to move, Space/Up to jump. Difficulty: Medium.

title: Gem Matcher
text: Swap gems to line up 3 or more. Chain combos for fever points before the 90-second clock runs out. Controls: Click/tap two adjacent gems to swap. Difficulty: Easy.

title: Starship Odyssey
text: Our flagship: captain the starship Odyssey across a story-driven multiverse in the style of classic space operas — nebula sectors, robot worlds, candy nebulas and noir stations, with crossover guests from across the Signature universe. Chart sectors, beam down, make choices, and bring the ship home. Controls: Arrows/WASD to steer the ship, Space to scan/pulse, E to beam down at stations. Difficulty: Story — everyone finishes.

title: Shadow Strike Ops
text: Modern combat-style top-down ops: clear 8 waves of hostiles with rifles, grenades and airstrikes. Stay in the light. Controls: WASD to move, aim with mouse, click to fire, G grenade, Q airstrike. Difficulty: Hard.

title: Neon Maze
text: A glowing first-person maze rendered in retro raycasting. Find the exit core before your energy drains. 5 mazes, deeper each time. Controls: W/S or Up/Down to walk, A/D or Left/Right to turn. Difficulty: Medium.

title: Asteroid Miner
text: Blast the rocks, tractor the ore, dodge the debris. Every chunk of ore is credits — bank 1,000 to clear the belt. Controls: Arrows to thrust/turn, Space to mine-blast. Difficulty: Medium.

title: Neon Siege
text: Tower defense: build blasters, frost and cannon towers along the winding road. Hold 12 waves. No leaks. Controls: Click a tower type, then click the field to build. Click a tower to upgrade. Difficulty: Hard.

title: Pong Legends
text: The original duel, remastered: first to 7 against an AI champion that learns your angles. Pure reflex. Controls: Up/Down arrows or mouse to move your paddle. Difficulty: Adaptive.

title: Sky Hopper
text: One-button flight: tap to flap through the neon gates. Chain perfect gates for fever. How far can you hop? Controls: Space / click / tap to flap. Difficulty: Easy to start, brutal later.
